Use only the tools exposed for this stage. Use read_documents to batch several needed pages in one call, avoiding repeated model round-trips. Use the supplied stage-scoped catalog; do not read arbitrary paths or earlier runs. The originating study and its explanations remain hidden. For case units, definitions or processing facts, use request_case_definition; an isolated service releases only reviewed neutral facts with opaque evidence IDs. General literature retrieval remains restricted to independently dated earlier sources. You may reason conditionally while a case fact remains unknown. Use search_sources for actual missing public knowledge; returned access depth is explicit, not proof of relevance. analyze_csv reads every selected row, not the 12-row preview. Submit once using submit_result; if validation fails, the draft is saved locally. Use patch_result with the latest draft_ref and only changed fields; do not regenerate unchanged text. Original submissions remain archived. Every result requires summary (nonempty string) and artifacts, evidence, claims, limitations, next_actions (arrays, empty allowed), plus stage-specific fields. For development_step focus/uptake source, use a supplied source ID, document ID or unambiguous registered filename. Use a source-field locator instead of copying an exact quote when convenient. A registered document ID/path suffices if no specific field is selected; optional paraphrases are stored separately from exact quotes. For a JSON source, quote the exact string VALUE, without adding its field name. Alternatively supply quote_pointer (JSON pointer to a string) and omit quote; the exact selected string will be resolved and logged. For learning_request, context_ref="development_step" may replace duplicate gap/why_now strings; this references your own gap/reason, never changes its content. For sources[].local_path use the returned D-document ID to avoid copying long paths; it resolves to the exact registered file. source_use covers exactly broker_reply_source_ids, not the whole source catalog or new searches in this turn. Cite newly read tool sources in evidence/memory_notes with actual paths/URLs. Keep result text concise; use 0-1 useful memory notes unless multiple are necessary. Preserve branches and open issues. files is an object of relative artifact paths to complete text content; every declared artifact must exist or be provided in files. If artifacts is empty, your exact summary is saved automatically as an artifact; do not repeat the entire JSON as prose. For review-index-v2, start with the stage directory and read relevant result/before-input sections by document ID. Summaries are incomplete navigation excerpts, not evidence. Start with input_refs and inline bodies, not the entire provenance catalog. When reading a needed document, request the relevant JSON pointer or a useful page (up to 12000 characters); avoid repeated tiny probes. For review, source_stage must match the stage containing the exact quote; note_keys are actual memory_notes keys (often empty), not JSON field names. If an input body is omitted or represented by $document, read it by ID. No scientific text was summarized; originals and before-inputs remain readable. Online retrieval is enabled.

Execute agent_learn.md's learning and co-questioning plan. Chinese readable artifacts.
Do not read earlier project runs/candidates. Only use listed inputs, their cited source files,
the current case's exchanges, supplied memory, and public sources. A previous task is accessible
only through the supplied memory packet and its provenance. Do not scan old run directories.
Read the actual common sources behind summaries. Treat published findings as published knowledge.
Do not present them as discoveries. Preserve disagreements and all idea branches.
Use public sources via urllib/curl (Crossref, Europe PMC, PMC, arXiv, publishers as accessible).
Save retrieved text and exact URLs; distinguish full text, abstract and failed access.
No solving, scientific validation experiment, proof or novelty gate is required for ideas.
Small worked calculations are allowed to learn a concept, clearly labelled learning examples.
Save result.json with the six runtime fields plus the requested fields. Use summary as a STRING.
Do not spend your entire budget retrieving; save useful partial understanding if needed.
Study your actual controller reply. Identify directly relevant sources, transferable methods and irrelevant results; explain what changes in your assumption and what remains open. Classify every returned source; not_read is valid for sources not studied. Return source_use:[{source_id,relation:direct/method/irrelevant/not_read,reason}], learning_change, and an optional next learning_request. Label hypothetical worked examples. 
Also return memory_notes: 0-3 reusable notes; [] when unchanged. Each object has:
key (stable lower_case ASCII concept key; reuse an existing key when correcting it), title,
kind (source_knowledge/interpretation/hypothesis/correction),
mastery (read/explained/used; identify how the knowledge informed actual research when used),
understanding, conditions, open_questions (nonempty strings), optional example (text or null),
tags (array, include English and Chinese terms), sources (array of actual URLs or source paths),
revision_reason (required when the key already exists).
Separate published knowledge, your inference and untested hypotheses. 'Unknown' is a valid
open_questions string, never invent competence. Describe corrections explicitly.
Also return memory_use: array of {key,source_task,used_for,scope_check} for notes actually used;
return [] if none. State what you still cannot explain/use.


HYPOTHESIS DEVELOPMENT v3:
Use your disciplinary understanding and screened long-term memory to develop assumptions.
Start from a specific phenomenon, tension, difficulty or missing relation. When you have a
possible explanation or organizing principle, state what you suppose; merely changing a
'whether' question into an affirmative sentence adds no insight. An assumption can be an
explanation, conjectured relation, representation, distinction or method/construction principle.
Explore what conceptual move it makes and, CONDITIONALLY on the assumption, what changes in
our understanding or possible actions. Develop concrete consequences, not promises of impact.
Use these as thinking moves, not a checklist that every early idea must already satisfy.
Before requesting learning, identify a specific missing conceptual connection in the current
assumption, why it matters, and what understanding might change. Return to that same gap after
reading: explain a revised premise, relation or conditional consequence, or retain the gap.
Do not substitute more citations, caveats, controls or formal wording for conceptual development.
Measurement/method contributions remain valid when their concrete intellectual consequences are
articulated. No compulsory mechanism, scientific breakthrough, or progress at each turn.

In peer discussion, engage a specific assumption: elaborate a consequence, expose a hidden
premise, connect a disciplinary concept, propose a distinct explanation, or revise a relation.
Explain the reasoning. You may retain, revise, branch, or park your own line. No forced consensus,
disagreement, novelty claim, completed hypothesis or compulsory new branch each turn.
Evidence strength, proof, available data/tools, implementation and experimental feasibility
are NOT requirements for proposing, retaining or prioritizing a hypothesis. Do not turn
discussion into a feasibility review. Research/analysis requests remain optional resources
for thinking. Correct concrete errors in premises while keeping conditional hypotheses distinct
from established observations; lack of evidence alone is not a refutation.

hypothesis_state.self contains your saved branches; peer_branches belong to their named owners.
Return hypothesis_updates: [] when nothing changed, otherwise full cards:
{key: stable local identifier [A-Za-z0-9_]+, base_version: 0 for new or supplied own version,
assumption: nonempty provisional claim, motivation: specific phenomenon/difficulty/relation,
conceptual_move: string or null if still unclear,
implications: [specific conditional consequences, may be empty],
open_questions: [unresolved conceptual questions, may be empty],
status: developing/parked, reason: why propose/change/park/resume,
influenced_by: [exact ref objects from supplied hypothesis_state],
depends_on: [exact supplied hypothesis refs used as premises; [] if none]}.
Influence is not logical dependence. Declare depends_on only for actual premises; do not invent
links. revision_obligations lists your branches whose declared premises changed or themselves
await review. This does NOT mean the branch is false. For each obligation return
 dependency_responses:[{ref:exact hypothesis_ref,action:revise/reaffirm/park/unresolved,reason}].
Reaffirm/revise requires an updated full card citing current dependency versions; changing only
links is recorded as provenance maintenance, not conceptual progress. Park/unresolved retains
the branch and its warning. Reasoned reaffirmation is valid; do not mechanically follow criticism.
Dependencies not explicitly declared cannot be inferred by this structural checker.
Omitting a branch retains it. To keep an alternative, use a new key and cite the parent ref;
never overwrite a peer's branch. Missing conceptual_move or implications is allowed for an
early assumption. Keep hypothetical consequences explicitly hypothetical, including examples.
Reusable conceptual learning can also be saved through existing memory_notes, kind:hypothesis,
with actual source provenance and same-key revisions. Run-local branches do not replace your
long-term disciplinary memory or its source screening. Do not invent empirical support.


Optional learning_request: {needed:boolean, gap, why_now, queries:[strings],
urls:[], source_ids:[], record_ids:[], operations:[], case_questions:[]}.
Use case_questions for actual case definitions/units/processing order; literature cannot
reconstruct undocumented case facts. These questions dispatch even when needed:false.
General theory and explanation-development requests use queries/gap. For case facts, the
isolated material service releases supported neutral definitions, not hidden conclusions.
The controller searches and returns actual readable content. Keep your own scientific query;
classify returned sources as directly relevant, transferable method, or irrelevant, with reasons.
Do not treat a successful download as understanding. No compulsory tool use.
For a small worked calculation use an operation {kind:"calculation", question,
bindings:{name: numeric scalar/array}, expression: numeric array expression,
expected: optional numeric value/array}. Available arithmetic, slices and named functions
include mean,sum,std,norm,diff,abs,sqrt. Define which rows/columns mean which entities.
Top-level analysis_plan also dispatches. needed:false disables literature search, not explicit
calculations. Unsupported requests return a pending capability task; no scientific rejection.
Keep purely tentative proposals in hypothesis_updates/next_actions, not execution fields.


HYPOTHESIS CONTENT CYCLE:
Use development_cycle as a thinking context, not a demand to invent progress. Choose one
specific explanatory relation, construction, distinction or unresolved phenomenon from its
sources. Locate the conceptual gap: what connection/premise/consequence is still unclear?
Choose a next move because of this gap: learn, derive, connect, reframe, or hold. Explain why
that move could change understanding. For learning, use this gap in learning_request.gap and
why_now, and formulate targeted queries; do not request a broad survey merely to fill a stage.
In discussion, take up a peer's concrete relation and explain how your discipline extends,
challenges or changes its consequences. Generic agreement about controls or feasibility is
not a substitute; a measurement contribution is valid when its specific consequences matter.
Study returned services against the gap that requested them, including failures and pending
capabilities. Do not call retrieval success learning. If nothing changes, say so and preserve
the gap. Own previous_steps carry unfinished thinking across phases and sessions. When the
controller flags repeated_no_change, reconsider the missing connection, premise, or next
learning move; holding a branch is valid. The flag uses supplied peer content comparisons, not a quality verdict. A shared interpretation is normal.
Return development_step:{focus:{source:exact development_cycle.sources key,quote:exact excerpt},
gap:nonempty text, action:learn/derive/connect/reframe/hold, reason:nonempty text,
expected_change:text or null for hold,
uptake:[{source:exact source key,quote:exact excerpt or null only for unresolved,
effect:revise/extend/challenge/unchanged/unresolved,reason:how this affects the focus,
consequence:conditional consequence or null when none follows}],
outcome:{kind:relation/implication/clarification/unchanged/uncertain,
statement:what changed or did not, remaining_gap:text or null}}.
Account once for EACH service key in required_service_uptake. If peer_sources is nonempty,
engage at least one (unresolved with a reason is valid). Other uptake is optional. Quotes must
come from the named source; for published claims quote readable source content, not metadata.
For relation/implication outcomes, preserve the resulting claim in a hypothesis_update's
assumption or implications. This records an author's proposal, NOT confirmed novelty/progress.
No compulsory new relation, branch, agreement, data, experiment, proof or implementation.


QUESTION STATE PROTOCOL v2:
question_state.self is YOUR authoritative current personal question. peer_questions belong
to their named owners. shared_question is the discussion's current shared question, or null.
Do not reconstruct your prior question from the latest peer message. The controller records
the actual before-state; do NOT return question_before or question_after.
Return personal_question_update: {base: the exact self.ref object, action: retain/revise,
question: your current or revised personal question, reason: a nonempty explanation,
influenced_by: array of exact question ref objects from this supplied packet}.
Retain means the question text stays exactly the same. Revise may include adopting a peer's
line or the shared question: explain why; use influenced_by to identify relevant question refs.
You need not preserve disagreement or a distinct personal question if you decide to change it.
Separately return shared_question_update: null, or {base: the exact shared_question.ref (null
if none yet), action: propose/revise/retain, question: shared question text, reason: nonempty,
influenced_by: array of refs from this packet}. Propose is only for a first shared question.
A shared question is a versioned proposal, not proof of peer agreement. Revising it NEVER
changes another researcher's personal question. Your own personal update is independent too.

Use controller-owned question_state, never invent question_before/question_after.
Keep hypotheses tied to specific entities/relations in this situation. A measurement or representation contribution is legitimate; explain its concrete consequences without forcing a natural mechanism.

They are described as discrete sums of simple hysteresis operators but can easily be reformulated as integral equations of continuous distribution functions using either a Preisach weight distribution function or a play distribution function. The models are mostly seen as phenomenological or mathematical tools but can also be related to friction-like pinning of domain-wall motions, where Rayleigh's law of magnetic hysteresis can be seen as the simplest case on either the play model or the Preisach model. They are poor at modeling other domain behavior, such as nucleation-driven hysteresis. Yet another hysteresis model is the stop model, which can be seen as the inverted version of the play model. This type of model has advantages for expressions linked to energy and can be related to Steinmetz equation of hysteresis losses. The models share several mathematical properties, such as the congruency property and wiping-out property, and both models have a history of dependence that can be described by the series of past reversal points. More generally, it is shown that the many models can be expressed as Preisach models, showing that they can be treated as subcategories of the Preisach type models. messages.reasoning_content:
Excellent. Now I have very substantive content.

Key learnings:

1. K1a032ca82ad45c41 (crumpled sheets; actually it's the crumpled-sheet hysteron paper? Let me check: the text at 86500-102500 describes crumpled Mylar sheets, hysterons with FM and AF interactions, RPM with nested loops, simulation of interacting hysteron network highlighting frustration). Wait — the review said K1a032 "Directly reports an interacting-hysteron network with both ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic interactions/frustration that still exhibits RPM and nested hysteresis loops... antiferromagnetic interactions imply loss of no-passing, while RPM can occur without no-passing." Hmm, the crumpled sheet paper — likely "Return point memory in crumpled sheets" or Shohat/Lahini? Actually there is a known paper: "Mechanical memory in crumpled sheets" ... but also "Lindsey, Shohat, Lahini, R... " Hmm. Wait, the crumpled sheet with FM/AF interactions and RPM — could be "Memory of many deformations in crumpled sheets" (Shohat, Lahini, Shokef?). Note: There's a 2023 PNAS "Pulling the memory out of crumpled sheets"? Actually I recall: D. Shohat, D. Hexner, Y. Lahini, "Memory from coupled instabilities in crumpled sheets" (PRL 2022). And a companion paper "Multiperiodic orbits from interacting soft spots" (Hexner?). The second one (with polytope J_ij, period-3 orbits) is likely K54d0 = "Multiperiodicity from interacting soft spots" (Phys Rev E / PNAS?). Actually the structure "four distinct graphs on N=5 vertices with three missing edges" + spin glass model + amorphous solids multiperiodicity = likely the paper by Lindeman & Nagel? Hmm — "Multiperiodicity in driven amorphous solids" — Actually it sounds like "Periodic dynamics in driven amorphous solids" — the paper "Multiperiodic dynamics from interacting soft spots" Kelly & ... Let me not worry about attributions; I'll cite by ID.

Important content from K1a032 (crumpled sheets): 
- Systems show hysteresis; after a few cycles converge to limit cycle; RPM observed with high accuracy.
- Nested loops hierarchy as hallmark of RPM.
- Experiments show both AF and FM interactions between hysterons; AF = neighbor flip raises threshold; also avalanches.
- Note: "reversible regime: any smaller amplitude → new limit cycle enclosed, and returning is reversible; larger amplitude → irreversible, memory of largest strain."
- Notably: RPM in these experiments is established *within a limit cycle reached at a given max amplitude*, and tested by nested-loop protocols. And "reversible behavior occurs when lowering and then restoring the initial displacement amplitude" → this is exactly a "return point memory" test at the level of amplitudes.

This is critical for my branch: an interacting network with frustration (their simulations highlight inherent frustration) still exhibits RPM. So frustration ≠ RPM violation. This refutes the sufficiency claim of gauge_frustration_memory_class (that imbalance "may break" — actually more precisely: it removes the sufficiency of my proposed criterion; frustration is not enough). But careful: the paper observes RPM at *some* amplitudes; the same system (crumpled sheet) with a frustrated network can also show irreversible / history-dependent changes when going to larger amplitude — that's amplitude-driven, not frustration.

2. K54d0 (multiperiodicity in interacting soft spots): "frustrated interactions are always necessary for multiperiodic behavior" and "without frustration, RFIM supports RPM — a behavior that precludes a multiperiodic response". Also: multiperiodicity requires specific coupling polytope; probability T=3 ~ 2e-4 driven by parameter-space volume; they compute a Chebyshev center with "identical asymmetric couplings that set up a clear chirality". Also "H_0" field; "amplitude sweep for the driving field". Also key: period-3 orbits require asymmetric couplings (chirality). This is gold: RPM violation ↔ multiperiodicity ↔ requires frustration (necessary) AND precise coupling relations (a polytope in J-space) — i.e., measure-zero-ish but robust-ish. And they note it may be associated with unjamming.

So: frustration necessary, not sufficient; and multiperiodicity (period T>1 under cyclic driving) is the operational signature/definition of RPM failure. That gives me a *third* discriminator for network_C: my 16 events = two identical 8-event blocks → if those are consecutive drive cycles at fixed amplitude, period-1 = no RPM violation at this amplitude. Whereas a frustrated network with a T=3 orbit would show a period-3 sequence. So the anomaly in network_C (the s3 missing event) is *within-period* structure, not multiperiodicity. That is a strong conceptual distinction: "scrambled" (intra-period transition graph off Preisach) vs "l-RPM violation" (multiperiodic orbit / failure to return).

This refutes/reorganizes my own framing: I had conflated l-RPM violation with "broken nesting/frustration". Now: multiperiodicity is the *consequence* of RPM loss, and it requires (i) frustration AND (ii) a coupling configuration inside a nontrivial polytope. So my "loop parity" criterion is at best a necessary condition, and the correct sufficient condition is a J-space inequality polytope (analogous to my latch inequality 2|b|≥gap!). That's a nice connection: their polytope in J-space is like my inequality 2|b_i| ≥ |A_i−A_j| — a region in coupling space, not a sign. This is a genuine conceptual convergence: memory-class distinctions are not topological invariants alone; they're *open regions in coupling space bounded by inequalities*, i.e., the same shape as my "latch as threshold inequality".

Also their FM/AF sign: in the crumpled-sheet paper, AF interaction = neighbor flip *raises* the threshold; FM = *lowers*. In my notation F_i^± = c_i + b_i σ: AF means b>0 (flip σ_j from -1 to +1 raises threshold). Yes consistent.

Another crucial item from K1a032: "antiferromagnetic interactions imply loss of no-passing, while RPM can occur without no-passing" (from relevance review). That's a two-level distinction: no-passing (Middleton) is stronger than RPM. My earlier memory: Preisach class requires ordering + no avalanches; scrambling. So there are THREE levels:
(1) no-passing (strongest: monotone, excludes avalanches in some sense)
(2) RPM / l-RPM (return point memory)
(3) Preisach representation (order-invariant, no scrambling)
And AF coupling ⟹ no-passing lost, but RPM retained. So "AF = dangerous" is wrong at the RPM level; AF does kill no-passing/scrambling-level description (Preisach). This is a precise, useful result for my ladder: b>0 (AF) → loss of Preisach/no-passing, but not RPM. That directly revises my earlier reading "pair_A ferromagnetic = protected" — both are protected at RPM level; AF breaks Preisach-class/no-passing. So there IS an observable difference between pair_A and pair_B at the Preisach level (not RPM level) — which slightly revises my v4 claim that "可观测差异只剩锁存方向". Actually it's an important correction: the difference is "which class of model describes them" — pair_B (AF) should fail no-passing even if RPM holds, hence its transition graph can be non-nested (crossing) yet still RPM. Hmm, and that connects to peer's "crossed independent hysteron pairs satisfy RPM exactly while having no single state-independent ordering" (from develop cycle earlier: "交叉的独立 hysteron 对（α 序与 β 序相反、无单一状态无关排序）仍精确满足 RPM"). Wow, exactly consistent: AF pair = no-passing lost, RPM retained.

Also K690a7 (serial hysterons, AF-like interactions break RPM): "hysteron-based metamaterials that leverage these interactions to realize targeted pathways, including those that break the return point memory property". So there exists a geometry where AF breaks RPM. And K1a032 shows frustration can coexist with RPM. Together: AF/frustration is neither sufficient nor... And K54d0 says frustration necessary for multiperiodicity.

Now, honest gap: How do these combine? Possibility: RPM violation in the serial AF case is not multiperiodicity but "targeted pathways" — i.e., a designed sequence where a specific state doesn't return. Hmm. Actually "break the return point memory property" for a *targeted pathway* — e.g., a hysteron that gets "pushed over" irreversibly at certain amplitudes. Multiperiodicity requires *periodic* driving, so violations under a prescribed complex sequence need not be periodic. So two distinct failure modes:
(a) failure to return to a previously visited state after a subloop (RPM violation proper, observable in a single nested-loop protocol);
(b) multiperiodic limit cycles under periodic drive (RPM violation in AC regime).
These are related but not identical. And the crumpled-sheet AF interactions lose no-passing but keep RPM.

That's a rich conceptual space. There's a genuine tension: K690a7 says AF couplings break RPM (in serial geometry), K1a032 says AF+frustration still gives RPM (in crumpled sheet). What differs? Possibly the *serial* (1D chain, no loop → actually a chain has no回路, so my "loop parity" criterion would say no frustration!). Important: a serial chain of 3 hysterons — is AF along a chain frustrated? In Ising terms a chain is balanced (product of signs along a path...). But serial coupling in mechanical hysterons is not a symmetric pairwise interaction: it's *directed* — the coupling goes through the shared elastic element, making it effectively asymmetric (hysterons in series: flipping one shifts the other's thresholds asymmetrically; the "interaction" is not reciprocal since each is driven by a common force vs displacement). Hmm — indeed K690a7's key is "geometrically controllable AF-like interactions" in serial configurations, and there's a known paper (Lindeman, ... "Hysterons in series"?) Actually: "Serially coupled hysterons" — the paper by C. W. Lindeman, T. Devic, D. Z. Rocklin? Or "Bense & van Hecke: 'Hysterons in series'". Hmm, "Complex pathways in serially coupled hysterons" (van Hecke group?). I recall: H. Bense & M. van Hecke, "Complex pathways and memory in compressed corrugated sheets" PNAS 2021; and "Unlocking hysterons in serial" — there's a 2024 paper "Serial hysterons: interactions and memory" showing AF-like interactions in series break RPM. Anyway.

Key conceptual point: *serial* coupling is intrinsically asymmetric in the (σ_i, σ_j) sense? No — AF like interaction means when one flips, the other's threshold changes *up*, i.e. "negative" interaction. In a chain, that's not a loop, so my gauge argument would say the sign can be gauged away (flip σ_2 label: c_2 → -c_2, i.e., thresholds swap). Right! Flipping label of rotor 2 maps AF to FM along edges 1-2 and 2-3, but requires relabeling which "0/1" is which state — for a physical hysteron whose two states have fixed identity (e.g., up/down), the gauge is unphysical but for the *transition graph topology* it's equivalent. However, in a serial chain the *order* of state switching matters and the relabeling also swaps α and β. In an AF pair, the map α↔β (reversal) is real. Hmm, but RPM is symmetric under reversal so it should be invariant. So why does AF break RPM in serial chains but my gauge says signs are absorbable?

Possible resolution: In serial chains the *interaction strength* is asymmetric (b differs depending on direction) — K690a7's abstract says "antiferromagnetic-like" — that "like" signals the interaction is not exactly a symmetric ±b; it's non-reciprocal/asymmetric. So it's not a pure ±b edge → falls into my branch (b) "not writable as ±b". That would be a nice resolution: the serial AF case breaks RPM precisely because the interaction is *asymmetric* (which direction flips whom), not because of sign. This is a checkable reading, and it supports my two-tier criterion but demotes loop parity to necessity.

I should get more of K690a7's content to check. Where is it? Between 102500 and 110000 presumably (the corrugated sheet setup text at 110000 — wait, 110000 showed "mechanical testers ... edge constraints ... cylindrical" which is the crumpled sheet paper's methods! Hmm. That's likely still K1a032 or Kdca177? The crumpled sheet has two testers (cylindrical and flat) — that matches K1a032's Fig 1A. So the crumpled-sheet text continues to ~115000? Then K690a7 and Kdca177 after? But 135000 was multiperiodicity (K54d0). Hmm, K54d0 might be a paper about "multiperiodicity in amorphous solids" which is actually the same group as crumpled sheets. And Kdca177 = corrugated sheets with Preisach→scrambled pathways (Bense & van Hecke PNAS 2021?) — that would be at ~115000-130000.

So where's K690a7 (serial hysterons)? Maybe between 102500 and 110000. Let me read 102500 limit 7500 and then 116000 limit 5000.

Let me check budget. I've used a fair amount. I still need to read my own prior result (D65ec...) for continuity, and perhaps peer's latest. Actually I have the develop cycle + hypothesis state which summarizes. The 04_targeted_1_learn_0 result — I might skip detailed read; my hypothesis state carries it.

Reads needed:
- 102500 limit 7000 (rest of crumpled + start of next)
- 114000 limit 6000 (corrugated/serial)

Let's do those two.

Even when it does not converge, often consecutive cycles yield very similar stress–strain curves and appear as approximate limit cycles.\\nFollowing the same protocols as in experiments, we find that the model recovers all essential experimental findings: memory of the largest strain, a tilt in the stress–strain curves, and change to the activation pattern when increasing the strain amplitude and, after training, the nested loops which characterize RPM ( Fig. 5  B  and  C ). Background: Experimental micrograph.\\nRecent simulations using athermal quasi-static shear have revealed an even more remarkable behavior in which the period of particle motions is a multiple of the period of driving ( 1 ,  10 ), reminiscent of the familiar action of a retractable pen. {"draft_ref": "D030973e875c6484d8253", "edits": [{"op": "set", "path": "/files", "value": {"notes/04_targeted_1_learn_1_two_axes_zh.md": "# 04_targeted_1 学习笔记：R/P 两轴与 9 个返回源的分类

性质说明：本笔记是作者本人的阅读记录。第一节是访问深度与分类，第二节只复述**已发表**内容（原文摘录存放在 result 的 evidence/source_use 中），第三、四节明确标为**我的推论/条件性假设**，第五、六节列仍未解决项与与 peer 的分歧。

## 一、返回源逐条分类与访问深度

| source_id | 读到的内容 | 访问深度 | 分类 | 理由 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| K1a032ca82ad45c41 | PMC9282240 正文（≤50000 字符）：同一相互作用 hysteron 网络同时含铁磁与反铁磁耦合、明确失去内部状态偏序，却高精度保持 RPM 与嵌套环 | 全文 | direct | 提供拆分两轴所需的关键事实，并否掉『受挫=记忆破坏』的充分性用法 |
| K54d08f3cba748af2 | 正文：挫折是多周期的必要条件；无挫折的 RFIM 支持 RPM；T=3 轨道对应耦合空间中的一个多面体区域，并落在 1<H0<1.685 的幅值窗口 | 全文 | direct | 提供我缺的三个构件：必要性、耦合空间开区域、幅值窗口 |
| K690a760e178df473 | 串联系机械 hysteron 的 AF-like 相互作用可实现破坏 RPM 的定向通路 | 仅摘要 | direct（限该几何） | 是『AF 永不破坏 RPM』的反例；但无法核对是否非互易，只用于压住普遍化表述 |
| Kdca177429482b145 | 随相互作用强度出现 Preisach→scrambled→accumulator 三级通路 | 仅摘要 | method | 可迁移为 P 轴（可表示性）分级框架；未报告 RPM，不能用于 R 轴 |

| Kb13a292195bd0cd6 | 仿生/智能算法综述，仅在参数辨识处偶发提及 Preisach | 扫读数​千字符正文 | irrelevant | 与本问题的返回性/可表示性无关，且占用本轮主要篇幅预算 |
| Kc950fc94ed37d2cd | FORC 表征 Ni 纳米线与合成反铁磁三层膜 | 仅摘要 | irrelevant | 仅共享『相互作用/反铁磁耦合』词，方法亦非所需 |
| Ke097673d6687fdd8 | 荷马史诗 hysteron proteron 的修辞研究 | 正文片段 | irrelevant | 仅共享词形，与迟滞无关 |

## 二、两条已发表事实（不是我发现的）

1. **受挫 ≠ RPM 破坏**：在含铁磁与反铁磁相互作用、相互作用强度不可忽略的 hysteron 网络中，体系失去内部状态的偏序（no-passing 失效），却仍以高精度保持 RPM，并可用嵌套环编码多个记忆（K1a032ca82ad45c41）。
2. **挫折是必要条件，而非充分条件**：受挫相互作用是多周期行为的必要条件；无挫折的 RFIM 支持 RPM，而 RPM 排除多周期响应。T=3 轨道落在耦合空间的一个多面体区域内（含非对称耦合与手性），并只在一个幅值窗口内出现（K54d08f3cba748af2）。

## 三、两轴区分（我的推论，非已发表）

- **R 轴（返回性）**：被访问状态是否会返回；可观测失效形态是多周期轨道 T>1。
- **P 轴（通路可表示性）**：通路能否由与状态无关的排序（no-passing / Preisach）描述；分级为 Preisach→scrambled→accumulator。
- 符号 b 的作用在两轴不同：对 R 轴可以当作标签翻转吸收；对 P 轴不能——子格翻转保持逐元素换态序列 ρ 与各元素自身的 α、β 顺序，却反转该元素相对共同驱动的取向，从​而反转元素间偏序。
- 据此：pair_A（全 b<0，FM）与 pair_B（全 b>0，AF）在 R 轴同类、在 P 轴异类；network_C 的 16 个事件若能读成两个逐项相同的 8 事件周期，则指向 R 轴在此幅值未损，而 s3 的『该翻未翻』属 P 轴。
- 我的 latch 不等式 2|b_i| ≥ |A_i−A_j| 归入 P 轴（同 γ 双翻/雪崩）；它与多周期判据同形，是因为两者都是耦合空间中的不等式区域，而不是符号不变量。

## 四、条件性推论（若两轴读法成立）

- 仅凭『某条回路符号乘积为 −1』不能预言 RPM 破坏；要预言必须同时给出耦合量级落入的区域与幅值落入的窗口。对本装置，回路奇偶只给风险上界，R 轴的实际检验只能靠嵌套环或周期长度。
- pair_A 在 L=4.731 处出现同 γ 双翻（雪崩），只说明 P 轴已离开 Preisach 区，不说明 R 轴受损。
- 挫折从『判据』降为『必要通道』：挫折 + 耦合空间中由不等式围成的开区域 + 幅值窗口，三者同时才谈 R 轴失效。
- 已发表的可表示性阶梯与 R 轴不是同一条单调轴：同一体系可同时处在 P 轴的高级（scrambled/accumulator）与 R 轴的良好（RPM）。

## 五、仍未解决 / 未知

- K690a760e178df473（串联系 AF 破坏 RPM）与 K1a032ca82ad45c41（受挫仍保 RPM）的差别究竟是几何（串联系为单通道、无回路），还是非互易（该边不可写成 ±b）？只有摘要，无法判定。这决定『不可写成 ±b 的边』在 R 轴里是第二必要条件还是仅 P 轴特征。
- 两轴是否存在交叉点（accumulator 级别的相互作用是否连带破坏 R 轴）——unknown。
- 幅值窗口如何用弹簧-止挡装置的量纲量写出——unknown。
- network_C 的并联/交叉连接、回路与止挡角不在所供数值表内：判据在本装置上只能预言，不能检验；16 行无嵌套小环协议，故不能反过来断言 RPM 成立。

## 六、与 peer 的分歧（保留）

peer 把『存在与状态无关的释放次序』当作 RPM 的定义；我认为那是 P 轴（no-passing/Preisach 可表示性）的条件，RPM 只要求状态返回。这一分歧不是措辞问题：它决定 pair_A 与 pair_B 该被读成同类还是异类。

HYPOTHESIS DEVELOPMENT v3:
Use your disciplinary understanding and screened long-term memory to develop assumptions.
Start from a specific phenomenon, tension, difficulty or missing relation. When you have a
possible explanation or organizing principle, state what you suppose; merely changing a
'whether' question into an affirmative sentence adds no insight. An assumption can be an
explanation, conjectured relation, representation, distinction or method/construction principle.
Explore what conceptual move it makes and, CONDITIONALLY on the assumption, what changes in
our understanding or possible actions. Develop concrete consequences, not promises of impact.
Use these as thinking moves, not a checklist that every early idea must already satisfy.
Before requesting learning, identify a specific missing conceptual connection in the current
assumption, why it matters, and what understanding might change. Return to that same gap after
reading: explain a revised premise, relation or conditional consequence, or retain the gap.
Do not substitute more citations, caveats, controls or formal wording for conceptual development.
Measurement/method contributions remain valid when their concrete intellectual consequences are
articulated. No compulsory mechanism, scientific breakthrough, or progress at each turn.

In peer discussion, engage a specific assumption: elaborate a consequence, expose a hidden
premise, connect a disciplinary concept, propose a distinct explanation, or revise a relation.
Explain the reasoning. You may retain, revise, branch, or park your own line. No forced consensus,
disagreement, novelty claim, completed hypothesis or compulsory new branch each turn.
Evidence strength, proof, available data/tools, implementation and experimental feasibility
are NOT requirements for proposing, retaining or prioritizing a hypothesis. Do not turn
discussion into a feasibility review. Research/analysis requests remain optional resources
for thinking. Correct concrete errors in premises while keeping conditional hypotheses distinct
from established observations; lack of evidence alone is not a refutation.

hypothesis_state.self contains your saved branches; peer_branches belong to their named owners.
Return hypothesis_updates: [] when nothing changed, otherwise full cards:
{key: stable local identifier [A-Za-z0-9_]+, base_version: 0 for new or supplied own version,
assumption: nonempty provisional claim, motivation: specific phenomenon/difficulty/relation,
conceptual_move: string or null if still unclear,

status: developing/parked, reason: why propose/change/park/resume,

Influence is not logical dependence. Declare depends_on only for actual premises; do not invent
links. revision_obligations lists your branches whose declared premises changed or themselves
await review. This does NOT mean the branch is false. For each obligation return
 dependency_responses:[{ref:exact hypothesis_ref,action:revise/reaffirm/park/unresolved,reason}].
Reaffirm/revise requires an updated full card citing current dependency versions; changing only
links is recorded as provenance maintenance, not conceptual progress. Park/unresolved retains
the branch and its warning. Reasoned reaffirmation is valid; do not mechanically follow criticism.
Dependencies not explicitly declared cannot be inferred by this structural checker.
Omitting a branch retains it. To keep an alternative, use a new key and cite the parent ref;
never overwrite a peer's branch. Missing conceptual_move or implications is allowed for an
early assumption. Keep hypothetical consequences explicitly hypothetical, including examples.
Reusable conceptual learning can also be saved through existing memory_notes, kind:hypothesis,
with actual source provenance and same-key revisions. Run-local branches do not replace your
long-term disciplinary memory or its source screening. Do not invent empirical support.

HYPOTHESIS CONTENT CYCLE:
Use development_cycle as a thinking context, not a demand to invent progress. Choose one
specific explanatory relation, construction, distinction or unresolved phenomenon from its
sources. Locate the conceptual gap: what connection/premise/consequence is still unclear?
Choose a next move because of this gap: learn, derive, connect, reframe, or hold. Explain why

why_now, and formulate targeted queries; do not request a broad survey merely to fill a stage.

The models are mostly seen as phenomenological or mathematical tools but can also be related to friction-like pinning of domain-wall motions, where Rayleigh's law of magnetic hysteresis can be seen as the simplest case on either the play model or the Preisach model. They are poor at modeling other domain behavior, such as nucleation-driven hysteresis. Yet another hysteresis model is the stop model, which can be seen as the inverted version of the play model. This type of model has advantages for expressions linked to energy and can be related to Steinmetz equation of hysteresis losses. The models share several mathematical properties, such as the congruency property and wiping-out property, and both models have a history of dependence that can be described by the series of past reversal points.
